title: BillingProcessPostRequest
description: Datatype comun para POST /billing-process. El payload se valida segun el valor de processCode (discriminador), que selecciona una de las 4 variantes de proceso soportadas: SALE, SALE_BUNDLE, NEW_CUSTOMER, NEW_ACCOUNT. Cada variante reutiliza los datatypes comunes definidos en $defs (AttributeItem, ContactItem, OfferItem, ChargeItem, bundleMemberItem y sus variantes con 'operate') tal como estan modelados en los RAML datatypes de origen.

processCode.description: Discriminador del proceso de negocio. Determina que rama del oneOf aplica.

AttributeItem.description: Extended attribute key-value pair. Used en custAttrList, acctAttrList, billProdInstAttrList, billOfferInstAttrList.

attrCode.description: Attribute code as configured in ZSmart. -> attrCode

AttributeItemWithOperate.description: Extended attribute con operate explicito. Usado cuando CRM controla add/modify/delete de atributos (aplanado: no allOf, evita conflicto con additionalProperties:false del tipo base). NOTA: 'operate' se acepta pero no se exige — en trafico real (p.ej. SVA) a veces se omite.

attrCode.description: Attribute code as configured in ZSmart. -> attrCode

ContactItem.description: Contact person asociado a un customer, account o service. contactType varia segun contexto (Customer: 501-504, Account: 505-509,511, Service: 510).

contactId.description: Unique ID de ZSmart, mandatorio para modificar un contacto. -> contactDto.contactId

ContactItemWithOperate.description:
Contact con operate explicito. Todos los campos son opcionales excepto operate.
NOTA: 'operate' se acepta pero no se exige — en trafico real (p.ej. STRATUM_CHANGE) a veces se omite y se envia el contacto completo sin operate.

contactId.description: ZSmart contact ID. Mandatory cuando operate=M. -> contactDto.contactId

ChargeItem.description: One-off o advance charge. Usado en chargeList.

basicCharge.description: Charge amount en PESO. Debe ser positivo. -> charge.basicCharge

acctItemTypeCode.description: Account item type code configurado en ZSmart. -> charge.acctItemTypeCode

paidFlag.description: Y=paid en CRM, N=collect en ZSmart. -> charge.paidFlag

perCharge.description: Monthly charge amount para installment plans. -> charge.perCharge

prodInstFlag.description: Restrict charge a este subscriber. -> charge.prodInstFlag

origAcctItemTypeCode.description: Original account item type code. -> charge.origAcctItemTypeCode

OfferItem.description: Offer instance asociada a un service. Usado en billOfferInstList.

offerInstanceIdCRM.description: CRM offer instance ID (max 15 digitos). -> billOfferInst.offerInstIdCRM

attributes.description: Extended attributes para esta offer instance. -> billOfferInstAttrList

OfferItemAD.description: Offer instance con operate A o D unicamente. Usado en plan-change (aplanado).

operate.description: A=Add new offer, D=Delete current offer. -> operate

offerInstanceIdCRM.description: CRM offer instance ID (max 15 digitos). -> billOfferInst.offerInstIdCRM

attributes.description: Extended attributes para esta offer instance. -> billOfferInstAttrList

OfferItemWithOperate.description: Offer instance con operate explicito. Usado cuando CRM controla add/modify/delete de additional offers (aplanado).

offerInstanceIdCRM.description: CRM offer instance ID (max 15 digitos). -> billOfferInst.offerInstIdCRM

attributes.description: Extended attributes para esta offer instance. -> billOfferInstAttrList

bundleMemberItem.description: Bundle members asociados a un service.

operate.description: A=Add new bundle subscriber, M=Modify existing subscriber to bundle. -> bundleMemberList.operate

serviceNumber.description: Service number del subscriber sin prefijo. -> bundleMemberList.serviceNumber

Sale.description: SALE — New Connection (ZSmart serviceEventId=1). Crea customer, account y service en una transaccion atomica.

serviceNumber.description: CRM subscriber instance ID. Debe coincidir con el prodInstId del main service. -> header.serviceNumber

custId.description: Mandatorio si el customer ya existe. -> header.custId

acctId.description: Mandatorio si el account ya existe. -> header.acctId

customer.description: Omitir si el customer ya existe (usar transaction.custId). -> cust (operate=A)

account.description: Omitir si el account ya existe. -> account (operate=A)

originalDepartment.description: Requerido para Dedicated Links/MPLS/Corporate VPN. -> billProdInst.originalDepartment

SaleBundle.description: SALE_BUNDLE — New Connection bundle (ZSmart serviceEventId=808). Doble/Triple play; los services comparten bundleIdCRM.

serviceNumber.description: CRM subscriber instance ID. Debe coincidir con el prodInstId del main service. -> header.serviceNumber

custId.description: Mandatorio si el customer ya existe. -> header.custId

acctId.description: Mandatorio si el account ya existe. -> header.acctId

customer.description: Omitir si el customer ya existe (usar transaction.custId). -> cust (operate=A)

account.description: Omitir si el account ya existe. -> account (operate=A)

originalDepartment.description: Requerido para Dedicated Links/MPLS/Corporate VPN. -> billProdInst.originalDepartment

NewCustomer.description: NEW_CUSTOMER — Crea un customer en ZSmart sin service (ZSmart serviceEventId=806).

custId.description: Mandatorio si el customer ya existe (existing customer new connection). -> header.custId
Mandatorio si el customer ya existe. -> header.custId

NewAccount.description: NEW_ACCOUNT — Crea un billing account para un customer existente (ZSmart serviceEventId=807).

custId.description: Mandatorio — el account debe estar ligado a un customer existente. -> header.custId

acctId.description: Mandatorio si el account ya existe. No requerido para prepago. -> header.acctId
